from __future__ import annotations

import calendar
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from typing import Optional


def next_occurrence(due_date_iso: Optional[str], recurrence: Optional[str]) -> Optional[str]:
    """Return the next occurrence ISO date string based on recurrence.

    Handles end-of-month clamping for monthly recurrence.
    """
    if due_date_iso is None or recurrence is None:
        return None

    try:
        dt = datetime.fromisoformat(due_date_iso)
    except (ValueError, TypeError):
        return None

    if recurrence == "daily":
        next_dt = dt + timedelta(days=1)
    elif recurrence == "weekly":
        next_dt = dt + timedelta(weeks=1)
    elif recurrence == "monthly":
        month = dt.month + 1
        year = dt.year
        if month > 12:
            month = 1
            year += 1
        max_day = calendar.monthrange(year, month)[1]
        day = min(dt.day, max_day)
        next_dt = dt.replace(year=year, month=month, day=day)
    else:
        return None

    return next_dt.isoformat()
